reviewed_statements: DB1--DB7: all odd primitive dyadic Bernoulli values are units at every prime above 3; minus 3-primary class group vanishes.
DB8: locally constant cocycles for odd dyadic characters, with the exact prime-to-3 inertia-index condition, are coboundaries.
DB9: the original RH weight-minus-two residual character equals eta4 times psi2^(-2); both odd quadratic factors and the square of the residual cyclotomic character cancel.
decisive_checks: The exact +/- pairing gives coefficients 2(a_j-a_{j+m/2})/2^n in {+1,-1}; no missing denominator or factor 2.
The two factors of X^(4h)+1 over F3 have degree 2h=ord_(8h)(3); every root has order 8h, so both factors are irreducible.
Modulo Y^2+sY-1, Y^3=-s-Y in F3, giving the stated two remainder coefficients. The required two zero three-sign sums contradict each other.
The small conductors 4,8,16 are handled separately and correctly.
The relative class-number formula is used only for the minus 3-primary part. Norm and extension of ideals give the required plus-part identification because 2 is invertible on 3-groups.
The inertia-index divisibility uses normality of I_K=I intersect G_K, now explicit in the frozen proof.
The actual source ML.IsCoc contains IsLocallyConstant by PrimitiveFrobeniusFixed/IsAdmissiblePrimeListNil.lean:98--99.

independent_exact_computations.all_sign_quadruples: All 16 quadruples in {+1,-1}^4 checked for both s=+1,-1; no simultaneous zero remainder.
independent_exact_computations.conductors: For n=3,...,12 the exact integer Bernoulli coefficients were computed from least residues of 5^j modulo 2^n, verified to be +/-1, and their polynomial gcd with Phi_(2^(n-2)) over F3 verified to equal 1.

limits: The all-n proof is mathematical, not inferred from finite tests. This review does not compute the integral Selmer groups, rebuild Lean, or close W04.
